entities.name: Sword of Asha
entities.description: Ancient relic, called the Shattered Sword after it broke; the weapon Asha used against Malfegor.

entities.name: Asha
entities.description: Angel who used the sword in her final battle against Malfegor.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: Enemy of Asha, later killed by Rafiq with the reforged sword.

entities.name: Sigil of Asha
entities.description: Sigil built into the sword's crossguard.

entities.name: Twelve Trees of Valeron
entities.description: Trees under which the twelve pieces of the sword were buried.

entities.name: Order of the Skyward Eye
entities.description: Order whose manipulation of the Prayer of Asha made the sword seem a myth.

entities.name: Prayer of Asha
entities.description: Prayer manipulated by the Order of the Skyward Eye.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: Time at which the sword was widely regarded as a myth.

entities.name: Mubin
entities.description: A rhox who realized the sword was real, dug up the pieces and had it reforged.

entities.name: Rafiq
entities.description: Received the reforged sword and killed Malfegor with it.

events.summary: In Asha's battle with Malfegor the sword was broken into twelve pieces buried under the Twelve Trees of Valeron.
events.quote: the sword was broken into twelve pieces, which were buried under the Twelve Trees of Valeron

events.summary: The Order of the Skyward Eye's manipulation of the Prayer of Asha makes the sword widely regarded as a myth.
events.quote: the Sword of Asha was widely regarded as little more than a myth

events.summary: Mubin realizes the sword is real, digs up the pieces and has it reforged.
events.quote: the rhox Mubin realized the sword was real, dug up the pieces, and had it reforged

events.summary: Rafiq is given the sword and kills Malfegor with it.
events.quote: Rafiq who managed to kill Malfegor with the weapon

relations.note: With the reforged Sword of Asha.
relations.quote: Rafiq who managed to kill Malfegor with the weapon
the weapon used by the angel Asha in her final battle against Malfegor
